title: Additivity of run length
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, $O$ an oracle language, and $c$ a configuration. For all nonnegative integers $a$ and $b$, running $M$ with oracle $O$ from $c$ for $a+b$ steps gives the same configuration as first running it for $a$ steps and then running it for another $b$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Nonnegative step counts a and b
